data.description:
Placeholder epic for Plan A from the UI/UX quality proposal (report: docs/proposals).

Problem: Tokens drift, off-scale spacing values, ad-hoc colors. LLM reviewers cannot reliably catch off-scale or off-token values.

Deliverables:
- .claude/design.md with YAML front-matter tokens (colors, spacing scale, type scale, radii, breakpoints) + prose rationale, seeded from .ui-discovery-cache/global/design-tokens.json.
- plugins/dso/scripts/design-md-lint.sh: given a diff, flags hardcoded hex/rgb, off-scale spacing/padding/margin/gap, off-scale font-size/line-height, broken token references, and WCAG contrast on new fg/bg pairs.
- Pre-commit gate wiring in .pre-commit-config.yaml.
- Post-batch Sprint check between Step 11 and Step 12.
- FP-recovery escape integration.

Maps to: Paradigm 3 (Tripartite governance / DESIGN.md) in docs/proposals UI design report.

Measurable outcome: <2% of merged UI commits introduce off-token values within one sprint after rollout.

Status: placeholder — requires /dso:brainstorm to expand into a full epic spec.
data.title: Plan A: DESIGN.md linter for deterministic token/spacing-scale governance
